item.title: Akestgenes #2665 the Twice-Born was broken and is whole again (2×). The House of Hyperenor
item.description: Akestgenes #2665 the Twice-Born was broken and is whole again (2×). The House of Hyperenor made room at the fire, but no one sat close. Akestgenes has drunk from Lethe 2 times and remembers little.

item.description: Akestgenes #2665 the Twice-Born was broken in the archipelago (plague). The bones lie scattered in Asphodel and will knit again; only fire unmakes the Sown.
